review.note: A15(4): the record was dated 1521-1524 from the item, and its own article title states "Siege of Fuenterrabia (1523-1524)". The lead says the siege "took place in 1523-24", after a Franco-Navarrese army "had taken it in 1521", so 1521 is when the town was taken and not when this siege was. The start is 1523 and the month the item gave for 1521 goes with it; the end day the item gives is inside the new span and stays.

title: Siege of Fuenterrabía (1523–1524)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Fuenterrabía (1523–1524)", at revision 1370741324, opens: "The siege of Fuenterrabía took place in 1523-24 by a Spanish army, after a Franco-Navarrese army had taken it in 1521 in a new incursion to reconquer the Kingdom of Navarre, which had been occupied since 1512 by troops from the unified Crown of Castile and Crown of Aragon." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1541712, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle of the Italian Wars, 1523-24". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
